premises.text: Beekeepers cannot efficiently inspect large multi-site hive operations in person, so problems are often discovered after hives die
premises.evidence_span: by the time the beekeeper discovers that a hive is having an issue, the hive will die

premises.text: In-hive sensors plus AI translate temperature, humidity, sound, weight, and geolocation into a human-readable hive health and behavior interface
premises.evidence_span: translate its temperature, humidity, sound frequencies, or really the signals that the bees send each other, the weight of the hive and its geolocation

premises.text: Affordable analytic packages (not expensive raw data) are sold in one-, two-, or three-package plans tied to profitable apiary outcomes
premises.evidence_span: We offer affordable analytics instead of expensive raw data

value.text: Remote hive monitoring that improves beekeeper decisions and prevents disease rather than only reacting after loss
value.evidence_span: improve their decision-making process and really prevent diseases instead of reacting to them

secondary_value.text: Sustainable and efficient pollination services through empowered beekeepers
secondary_value.evidence_span: empowering beekeepers to provide sustainable and efficient pollination services

causal_links.evidence_span: struggling to keep their bees alive
remotely follow their hive status in terms of health and behavior

notes: Colony-loss and food-pollination framing folded into need/value; 40% loss stats motivate P1. Sensor signal list folded into one monitoring mechanism. Pilot hive saves treated as traction evidence for P2. Anti-template: need / sensing platform / monetization separately revisable.
